method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: commsharbor_health
tools.title: Commsharbor health
tools.description: Read deployment health and build. Smoke tests wait for their own commit to appear here instead of racing edge propagation.

tools.name: commsharbor_logout
tools.title: Commsharbor logout
tools.description: Revoke the current session. Bootstrap/CSRF must belong to this browser and session. Other product sessions remain active.

tools.name: commsharbor_me
tools.title: Commsharbor me
tools.description: Read the current account profile and platform role. `user.id` is the shared-account ID. Organizations are not listed here: they live in the shared account, which does not list them inside products yet — open a workspace by its ID with `GET /api/organizations/{organization_id}`.

tools.name: commsharbor_context
tools.title: Commsharbor context
tools.description: Resolve the active organization identity. Read this before a write when you are not certain which tenant is active. Guessing is how data lands in the wrong organization. An organization API key answers `kind: api_key` with its scopes.

tools.name: commsharbor_organization_get
tools.title: Commsharbor organization get
tools.description: Open an organization by id: name, your role and the CommsHarbor plan. This is how a workspace is opened. Name and role come from the shared account (null with an organization API key, which carries neither); the plan is the organization's global entitlement in CommsHarbor.

tools.name: commsharbor_audit
tools.title: Commsharbor audit
tools.description: List tenant audit events. Audit records are never rewritten and never carry recipient PII.

tools.name: commsharbor_platform_context
tools.title: Commsharbor platform context
tools.description: Confirm the caller's platform role. Tenant ownership grants nothing here: platform access is a separate, explicit grant.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_google_catalog
tools.title: Commsharbor email google catalog
tools.description: Read authorized Google metadata. This does not prove DNS ownership. Requires the owner's account session; an organization key cannot authorize Google access. Requires an account session in this organization. Reads site metadata only. Google access and refresh tokens remain encrypted on the server.

service.description: search_console or analytics. Each connection has its own consent.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_google_connect
tools.title: Commsharbor email google connect
tools.description: Start five-minute Google consent with PKCE. Return an authorization URL. Signing in does not grant this access. Requires the owner's account session; an organization key cannot authorize Google access. Requires an account session in this organization. Reads site metadata only. Google access and refresh tokens remain encrypted on the server.

service.description: search_console or analytics. Each connection has its own consent.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_google_resolve
tools.title: Commsharbor email google resolve
tools.description: Resolve website addresses for up to 20 selected Analytics properties. Search Console does not use this route. Requires the owner's account session; an organization key cannot authorize Google access. Requires an account session in this organization. Reads site metadata only. Google access and refresh tokens remain encrypted on the server.

service.description: search_console or analytics. Each connection has its own consent.

properties.description: Authorized properties/ID values from the catalog, at most 20 unique entries.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_google_disconnect
tools.title: Commsharbor email google disconnect
tools.description: Remove this product's saved Google connection and pending consent. Existing email and service resources remain intact. Requires the owner's account session; an organization key cannot authorize Google access. Requires an account session in this organization. Reads site metadata only. Google access and refresh tokens remain encrypted on the server.

service.description: search_console or analytics. Each connection has its own consent.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_domain_products_list
tools.title: Commsharbor email domain products list
tools.description: Read or associate PageAudit and HookPulse with a domain in this organization. Native product access must be enabled. The private email backend confirms domain ownership in this organization. Selected native products must already be enabled. Association is idempotent.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_domain_products_add
tools.title: Commsharbor email domain products add
tools.description: Read or associate PageAudit and HookPulse with a domain in this organization. Native product access must be enabled. The private email backend confirms domain ownership in this organization. Selected native products must already be enabled. Association is idempotent.

services.description: At most two unique values: pageaudit and hookpulse.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_workspace_snapshot
tools.title: Commsharbor email workspace snapshot
tools.description: Read the current email workspace, DNS progress and recent jobs. The ID must match X-Organization-Id. Membership is checked again for each snapshot and delivered event. Events contain only an opaque change ID. DNS checks run in the private backend, with a 24-hour deadline and a visible resume action after pause.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_workspace
tools.title: Commsharbor email workspace
tools.description: Read the email workspace. No guest access. Members can read. Owners, admins and organization keys can manage email. The private service credential stays on the server. Mailbox passwords and message content are never returned.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_trial_activate
tools.title: Commsharbor email trial activate
tools.description: Start the free receive-only Trial for 7 days, once per organization: 1 GB shared storage, unlimited mailboxes and no outgoing SMTP or external filter forwarding. Requires a new workspace and operator-proved native quota. No guest access. Members can read. Owners, admins and organization keys can manage email. The private service credential stays on the server. Mailbox passwords and message content are never returned.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_domain_setup
tools.title: Commsharbor email domain setup
tools.description: Find an existing domain. Return its organization and domain IDs only when this exact caller can open that organization. Otherwise return existing: null. No guest access. Members can read. Owners, admins and organization keys can manage email. The private service credential stays on the server. Mailbox passwords and message content are never returned.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_domain_verify

tools.name: commsharbor_email_mailbox_update

quota_mb.description: Quota in MiB. Must fit the plan and current usage.

files_quota_mb.description: File allowance in MiB. The sum of mailbox allowances must fit files_gb in the plan. Zero disables files. Existing files are preserved.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_mailbox_password

The private service credential stays on the server. Mailbox passwords and message content are never returned.

password.description: New mailbox password: 14 to 128 characters, with no control characters.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_mailbox_resume

domain_id.description: Domain ID from the workspace, where the alias is created.

destinations.description: Existing mailbox addresses in this organization.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_alias_update
tools.title: Commsharbor email alias update

tools.name: commsharbor_email_job_get
tools.title: Commsharbor email job get
tools.description: Read one durable job in this organization. No guest access. Members can read. Owners, admins and organization keys can manage email. The private service credential stays on the server. Mailbox passwords and message content are never returned.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_service_request
tools.title: Commsharbor email service request
tools.description: Request an included service with activation on demand. No guest access. Members can read. Owners, admins and organization keys can manage email. The private service credential stays on the server. Mailbox passwords and message content are never returned.

service.description: Service code from the plan catalog.

tools.name: commsharbor_email_security_check
tools.title: Commsharbor email security check
tools.description: Check whether someone can send email as a domain: SPF, DKIM in common selectors, DMARC, MX, MTA-STS and BIMI, with a 0-100 score and the fixes, most severe first. Public DNS only. Free, no account. The same domain is served from memory for 10 minutes. A network can run 30 new checks per day. DKIM is looked up in common selectors only; `dkim_not_found` does not prove that no key exists. `incomplete: true` means a DNS answer failed and the score can be lower than the real one; `unread` names those parts, and a failed query never becomes a missing finding.

domain.description: Domain to check, such as example.com

tools.name: commsharbor_brazil_email_report
tools.title: Commsharbor brazil email report
tools.description: Read the monthly Brazil email security report: how many domains of city halls, state and federal government, banks and listed companies reject fake email (DMARC p=reject) and how they end SPF. Totals only, public DNS. Free, no account. Public DNS only, read once a month. The sample is built from Brazil's open company registry (Receita Federal, the email of each active head office) and the CVM register of listed companies. Only totals: no domain is listed. A share is `count / (com_mx - dmarc.nao_lido)`; domains without MX are left out. Only the DMARC policy classifies; SPF is counted but does not change the class. `percent` rounds each group to 100 by the largest remainder, the same rule as the page.
